title: PACE: Plug-and-Play Contextual Embedding for Feature Screening with Pretrained Tabular Foundation Models
abstract: arXiv:2609.23574v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: In high-dimensional tabular learning, feature screening provides a lightweight, model-agnostic way to remove irrelevant features before model fitting. However, scoring raw values directly can miss nonlinear or distributional structure. We introduce PACE (Plug-and-Play Contextual Embedding), which inserts a frozen tabular foundation model (TFM) column encoder before an existing feature-scoring rule, expanding each feature into a higher-dimensional contextual representation. Across controlled studies, PACE improves raw-space screening of complex nonlinear dependence with only modest additional encoding cost. These gains translate to downstream prediction on TALENT datasets: PACE-DC improves binary AUC by 0.077 and multiclass macro-AUC by 0.064, with a median normalized RMSE improvement of 0.063 across ten learners. Matched random-weight and random-feature controls show that PACE gains from pretrained structure beyond generic dimensional

translated_title: PACE：基于预训练表格基础模型的即插即用上下文嵌入特征筛选方法
translated_abstract: 在高维表格学习中，特征筛选提供了一种轻量级、与模型无关的方法，可在模型拟合前去除无关特征。然而，直接对原始值进行打分可能会遗漏非线性或分布结构。我们提出了PACE（即插即用上下文嵌入），它在现有的特征打分规则之前插入一个冻结的表格基础模型（TFM）列编码器，将每个特征扩展为更高维度的上下文表示。在对照研究中，PACE仅以适度的额外编码成本，改进了对复杂非线性依赖关系的原始空间筛选。这些收益进一步转化为TALENT数据集上的下游预测性能提升：PACE-DC将二分类AUC提升了0.077，多分类宏平均AUC提升了0.064，在十个学习器上归一化RMSE的中位数改进为0.063。匹配的随机权重和随机特征对照实验表明，PACE的收益来自预训练结构本身，而非单纯的维度扩展。
tldr: PACE通过在特征打分规则前插入冻结的预训练表格基础模型编码器，将特征扩展为高维上下文表示，从而以极小的额外成本显著提升高维表格数据的特征筛选效果和下游预测性能。
en_tdlr: PACE inserts a frozen pretrained tabular foundation model encoder before feature-scoring rules to expand features into higher-dimensional contextual representations, significantly improving feature screening and downstream prediction on high-dimensional tabular data at minimal additional cost.
